headline: EPS holds sequential gain, sharply higher y/y
summary_short: Valor Holdings reported Q2 FY2026 basic EPS of ¥120.85, up 64.3% y/y from ¥73.58.
summary_long: Basic EPS of ¥120.85 rose 64.3% year-over-year from ¥73.58, and was up 4.0% sequentially from ¥116.18 in the prior quarter. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
